subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve #8285 with a global `messages.ackText` config, a non-terminal plugin/channel hook, or only channel-specific placeholder features?
rationale: Current source proves the gap, but the permanent owner boundary and public config/API shape affect core, plugins, docs, and channel compatibility.

options.title: Define A Cross-Channel Contract
options.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract or hook that channels can implement consistently, with schema/docs/tests and per-channel capability proof.

options.title: Keep It Channel-Specific
options.body: Leave #8285 as the parent UX request and implement Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, WebChat, and Feishu placeholders through separate channel-owned issues.

options.title: Do Not Add Text Ack
options.body: Close this family as not planned and keep reactions, status reactions, and typing indicators as the supported acknowledgement mechanisms.

recommendation.title: Define A Cross-Channel Contract
recommendation.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract or hook that channels can implement consistently, with schema/docs/tests and per-channel capability proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact issue and is tied to shared acknowledgement and dispatch lifecycle history.
